claim: In the exact certified BR9.0 arithmetic fixtures, the declared controller seals one immutable configuration, mirrors signed angular-momentum-arrest requests, preserves reserve-aware unilateral feasibility, rate-limits commanded contact-load redistribution, reports desired and achieved residuals, retains command-not-measurement semantics, and enters STABILIZE only after the complete safe dwell.

evidence.certification_claim_boundary: This campaign can certify only the exact BR9.0 digest-bound existing-contact brace-controller arithmetic, mirrored arrest, bounded load-rate redistribution, explicit residual, and stable-dwell handoff scope; BR9.1 reserve, friction, existing-contact-set, detector-state, finiteness, strict-field, monotonic-tick, and delayed-reaction refusal scope; BR9.2 controller-to-force-map-to-finite-paired-actuator-to-command-ledger-to-executor-to-append-only-receipt scope; and BR9.3 paired no-brace-control and active-brace Godot/Jolt program scope named by the source-pinned programs. BR9.4 is integrity-only containment and cannot substitute for a milestone program. The live pair retains the exact BR7 material scaffold: an explicit unpowered Generic6DOF guide releases sagittal X/Y translation and pitch while locking out-of-plane translation, roll, and yaw; all guide motors and springs remain off; four hinges remain passive; and two ordinary distal contacts are already bearing before the one declared positive pitch impulse. The active controller begins only on the first post-impulse observation, redistributes commanded contact loads inside the declared unilateral, friction, reserve, load-rate, and finite-actuator boundaries, and is compared with a no-brace control receiving the same impulse. Whole-system angular-momentum reconstruction supplies the aggregate external pitch-moment check. Commanded left/right shares are not measured per-foot loads. This establishes scaffold-constrained planar existing-contact pitch arrest only, not a new-contact catch step, per-foot measured load allocation, free-3D bracing or standing, articulated-limb generality, fall arrest, getting up, gait, walking, creature repair, accepted knowledge, or automatic creature guidance.
